1.3.1.1.body:
Our Statutory Audit Services Include

Audit of Financial Statements

We conduct an independent examination of financial statements to ensure they are prepared in accordance with the applicable accounting framework.

Our audit includes:

  1. Audit of Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account, and Cash Flow Statement.
  2. Verification of accounting records and supporting documents.
  3. Review of accounting policies and estimates.
  4. Compliance with applicable Accounting Standards.

Compliance with Companies Act & Standards on Auditing

We ensure that the audit is conducted in accordance with the Companies Act, 2013 and the Standards on Auditing (SAs) issued by the ICAI.

Our review includes:

  1. Compliance with statutory provisions.
  2. Verification of statutory disclosures.
  3. Evaluation of financial reporting practices.
  4. Review of regulatory compliances.

Verification of Internal Controls

Strong internal controls improve financial reliability and reduce operational risks.

We assess:

  1. Internal financial controls.
  2. Accounting processes.
  3. Financial reporting systems.
  4. Risk management procedures.

Reporting & Audit Opinion

Upon completion of the audit, we issue an independent audit report highlighting our observations and expressing an opinion on the financial statements.

Benefits of Statutory Audit

  1. Compliance with the Companies Act, 2013.
  2. Improved financial transparency.
  3. Increased stakeholder confidence.
  4. Identification of financial and compliance risks.
  5. Strengthened internal controls.
  6. Reliable financial reporting.

Reliable Statutory Audit Services

Our statutory audit services help companies meet their legal obligations while improving financial governance, transparency, and stakeholder confidence through a structured and independent audit process.
